title: Nefact Texture Pack
description: The official resource pack for Nefact SMP and NefactPlugin.
body:
# Nefact SMP Resource Pack
The official resource pack for [Nefact SMP](https://modrinth.com/plugin/nefactplugin).

This pack contains custom item models and textures used by **NefactPlugin**, allowing artifacts and future content to appear with their intended designs.
## Features
- Custom item models
- Custom artifact textures
- Designed for NefactPlugin
- Regularly updated alongside the plugin
## Compatibility
This resource pack is designed for the latest supported version of Minecraft and should always be used together with **NefactPlugin**.
